worked_examples.hands_back: {"answer":"Screen \"Pick up on\" (was \"Fulfilment\"), button \"Reserve my loaf\" (was \"Submit\"), error \"That pickup time is full, pick another\" (was \"Processing failure\"), list \"Your reservations\" (was \"Orders v2\").","checks":{"naming-finger-point-test":"Three new readers each pointed to the same button for \"Reserve my loaf\" and the same date picker for \"Pick up on\".","naming-name-the-job":"Every label says what happens: \"Reserve my loaf\", \"Your reservations\"; the category word \"Fulfilment\" is gone.","naming-sentence-over-vague-word":"The pickup field is \"Day and time you will collect it\", a sentence, because \"Slot\" lost its meaning.","naming-state-the-actual-cause":"The full-day error says \"That pickup time is full, pick another\", not \"Processing failure\".","naming-translate-insider-terms":"The word \"SKU\" became \"item\" and \"cutoff window\" became \"last time to change your order\".","naming-meaning-not-sequence-number":"\"Orders v2\" is now \"Your reservations\"; \"New basket\" is \"Basket for groups\".","naming-claims-literally-true":"\"Unlimited changes\" was removed; it says \"Change your order until 6 pm the day before\", which is what the page does.","naming-fix-where-you-are":"Only the pre-order page names were changed; the admin screen names were left for their own change.","naming-examples-not-owner-names":"The shared date picker is named \"Day picker\", with the bakery pickup as one use of it.","naming-promise-matches-reality":"The \"Reply within an hour\" promise was checked against the inbox and changed to \"Reply the same day\"."}}
